english.note: Use this in a wood-finishing or surface-colouring context for a substance absorbed into the material to colour it.

examples.english: This wood stain soaks into the grain and gives it a much more natural colour.
examples.traditional: 呢種木器染料會滲入木紋，令個色自然好多。
